address: 5F, Park Place, 1601 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, Chinese Mainland
bio: This luxuriously appointed, light-drenched room melds Chinese classicism with modern minimalism. Supervised by master chef Zhou Xiaoyan, the kitchen focuses on the light, refined qualities that characterise Huai Yang cuisine. Braised ‘lion head’ meatball in premium stock showcases meticulous knifework and precise heat control; the meatball melts in the mouth and the stock is loaded with umami. The silky salt-brined squab is another must-try.
